items.title: Sherrie Maricle interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Like someone who I idolize with their stage presence and something I always try to learn from people who are great band leaders

ctx.x: until they stop playing the melody. They don’t quite know how to listen to it and I’m not sure that they really should.

It also boils down to the way that it’s presented also. And the artist. Like someone who I idolize with their stage presence and something I always try to learn from people who are great band leaders and understand what — I mean you can warm up to somebody really fast, you can really like someone even if you’re not a hundred percent convinced you like the music they’re playing. Like Clark [Terry] is so open and so warm and he’s just so, it’s like he just walks out and gives the audience a big hug or something.…
I love it when people do creative things, even with someone last night was doing—
